name: obsel
description: obsel watches a swarm of AI agents through DataHub's lineage graph and flags finished work that a later upstream change quietly invalidated.

scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:python && pnpm build
scripts.test:python: python3 -m agents.fingerprint && python3 -m agents.worker && python3 -m agents.agent_contract && python3 -m agents.runner_select && python3 -m agents.mcp_core && python3 -m agents.mcp_erasure && python3 -m agents.scale && python3 -m agents.swarm && python3 -m agents.run self-check
